question: Can compute and a collective overlap on the streams of this device?
why: The 19.3% of the decode step lost at collective barriers is straggler wait with every AI core idle. Overlap is the only remedy inside the protected contracts (routing cannot be rebalanced, and a faster collective cannot help a wait for compute that has not arrived).
verdict: no overlap: the two-stream time equals the no-overlap sum and is 26.6% slower than one stream
prior_independent_measurement: two 4096^3 BF16 matmuls on two streams 1078.4 us against 1043.3 us sequential, ratio 1.034
conclusion: Stream-level overlap is unavailable on this device for compute against compute and for compute against collective. The barrier wait is not recoverable by scheduling, so the execution-graph overlap route is closed.
note: The 301.7 us collective here is a cold synchronised measurement including launch and blocking wait; the same collective measures ~36 us in-graph. The overlap conclusion does not depend on that scale.
